subject: af-dy
title: AF.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 27 (BK(NM)-3). AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the subject; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), POL-CON (political consciousness) and ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From PROJ-DY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and AF-TD (affinity tendencies). From AF-TD: OBN, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From POL-CON: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From ACC-FT: DEC (decentralization). From DEC: CULT-COLD. From ALT-FT: EXP-DT (expansion dictates).
